name: cube50 (60 mm cube; folder name kept)
pivot_torque_note: at the foot hinge: Pololu 1000:1 HP N20, 0.245 N m stall, x 2.083 (12:25 then 14:16:14 through an idler, m0.5 hardened) x 0.95^3 = 0.438 (derived; 0.95 per mesh is a guess). Need: 1.5 x the worst pivot in the magnet sims (0.278 N m with side neighbours) = 0.417.
disc_torque_note: cap: Pololu #5199 298:1 HPCB 6 V with encoder, gearbox rating 2 kg cm = 0.196 N m x 14.29 (m0.5 12:40, m0.5 14:36, m0.8 12:20) x 0.95^3 = 2.40 N m; DRV8833 chop and firmware current cap 0.94 A (derived; 0.95 per mesh is a guess). In use at 1.5x: 1.6 N m.

disc_speed_torque.law: tau_max = min(cap, stall * (1 - |omega| / free)) when driving; cap when braking

disc_holds_unpowered: at a quarter turn: the lock pin, 6.7 N m (ring bearing yield, derived), engaged by default stowed and open, released by SMA; between quarter turns: gearbox back-drive friction only (not measured)
bond_note: guesses until the pull test: 80 N per pin under a stainless lip, 4 pins at r = 12 mm; the 50 mm design's 5.6 N m moment and 3.2 N m torsion scaled by the radius (x1.2); face magnets add 2.42 N in register (params magnets)
foot_mass_note: CAD parts that stay with a bonded foot: foot plate 14.7, 6800ZZ 8.0, hub 4.0, disc 2.8, pins 2.2, lip ring 1.6, lock ring and pin 1.4, knuckle 1.1, face magnets 0.8, cam ring 0.4 g, plus contacts (about 1 g, guess)
disc_axis: face normal of each foot; turns only while that foot is stowed
floor: 60 mm PLA tiles with the slot pattern and 9 mm top-edge chamfers (V-groove between tiles), needed for floor-roll pivots; a stowed cube stands and yaws on any flat floor

sim_results.pivot_with_deployed_knuckle: floor roll, climb up, climb down 10/10 each at 0.11 N m and at 0.085 N m; peak 0.085 N m; zero knuckle contacts (chamfered cubes, V-groove tiles, floor roll latched at the edge)
sim_results.walker_with_stowed_knuckles: 45.0 cm in 4 cycles at 10 s, zero knuckle contacts (same as without knuckles)
sim_results.arm_with_stowed_knuckles: lifts 1.15 cm, carries 17.5 cm, sets down 3.8 mm from the mark, zero knuckle contacts
sim_results.old_fixed_knuckle_for_comparison: walker 0.1 cm (all leg drives at the cap), arm fails: reproduces the film's conflict
sim_results.earlier_runs: walker 44-46 cm at 8, 10, 12 s; cap / 1.3 rows in results.jsonl (no knuckles)
sim_results.note_60mm: 50 mm rows above are history; 60 mm pivot rows with magnets are pivot_magnets_* in results.jsonl (0.315 N m hinge, scaled mass); rerun at the CAD mass and 0.438 N m pending

hinge.type: retractable: the axle and its knuckles sit inside the disc plane when the foot is stowed and slide onto the edge line for a pivot
hinge.axis_when_deployed_m: the foot's hinge edge line (feet[].hinge_axis_point_m, along feet[].hinge_axis_dir)
hinge.retract_dir: into the cube along both the foot's face normal and the +x face normal (stowed axle at x = 0.0258, z = +-0.0258); stroke 5.9 mm diagonal
hinge.stowed: nothing proud of any face (0.3 mm clearance), parts end at |y| <= 0.020
hinge.deployed: only during a pivot about that edge; parts lie in the support's chamfer channel or the tiles' V-groove
hinge.deploy_drive: DFRobot FIT0577 leadscrew (M3, cut to 11 mm) along x, nut carrier pin in a slot on the sled plate, 45-degree guides; self-locking; about 6 s per stroke (derived); 2 limit switches per hinge

planner_rules: a disc may turn only while its foot is stowed and its hinge retracted
a disc turns only after its lock pin is released (SMA), and stops at a quarter turn
do not turn a disc more than 20 degrees under an unbonded face (face magnets push it off with 2.42 N)
never put two cubes' hinges (stowed or deployed) on the same lattice edge
mass_note: CAD 2026-11-17 (cad/report.txt TOTAL 321.7 g, quick run; the CAD still has open assembly fixes, so this may move by a few grams)

magnets.status: chosen 2026-11-17 (sim); refit by the step-0 bench test (ASSEMBLY.md) before the parts order

layout.sites: 8 per face at +delta + 90k (pole plus_delta out) and -delta + 90k (the other pole out), angles counterclockwise seen from outside the face, from the face's e1 axis (magnets.py face_frames); same on all 6 faces of every cube; disc faces carry them on the disc
layout.envelope: CAD agent 2026-11-17 (derived): R + D/2 <= 8.3 mm; 2 R sin(min(delta, 45 - delta)) >= D + 0.8; T <= 2.0 under a 0.6 skin, pocket 2.7 deep; D 4 only at delta 22.5, R 6.3
layout.pole_rule: seen from outside each face, the site at +delta + 90k has N out and the site at -delta + 90k has S out; at delta 22.5 the 8 sites sit 45 degrees apart with alternating poles

part.Br_note: N35 nominal 1.17-1.22 T (source: grade tables); the bounds are checked at 1.17 (capture) and 1.24 (peel)

force_model.model: magnetic surface charge on the target, magpylib closed-form cylinder field of the source; rigid, mu_r = 1
force_model.scale_note: Br multiplier refitted by the step-0 bench test (ASSEMBLY.md)
force_model.exactness: quadrature over the target's charged surfaces against magpylib.getFT: under 0.5 % at contact (test); pairs beyond 45 mm left out (under 0.2 %, test)

encoders.source: cad/cube50_cad.py 2026-11-17: HENC_MAG 4 x 1 mm diametric on the axle end (y -22.1..-21.1 for the top hinge), board y -24.7..-24.1, chip toward the magnet; die taken at 5.9 mm inside the face plane (coordinator). Stowed axle at (x, z) = PR = (25.8, 25.8); deployed on the edge line (30, 30). Bottom hinge turned about x. Disc AS5600s removed (motor encoder plus lock index).

bounds.gravity_note: m g S / sqrt 2 with m 0.31 kg (scaled guess), S 0.06 m
bounds.hinge_note: 0.245 N m (Pololu 1000:1 at its rating) x 1.5 x 0.95^2: the task's figure; BOM.md's 18T-18T-18T (1:1) gives 0.221 N m, which leaves 0.018 N m for peel

weak_enough.rule: hinge >= 1.5 x (gravity + magnetic torque about the pivot edge)
weak_enough.met: yes for one face pair in contact (peel); no with side neighbours (see side_faces)

strong_enough.rule: closing torque about the hinge edge at the lead-in >= 2 x the foot's own gravity torque (a foot closing upward onto a face)
strong_enough.foot_mass_note: guess: the 50 mm foot parts (about 21 g, cad/report.txt) with printed parts scaled by 1.2^3
strong_enough.lead_in: 2 degree wedge at the hinge (gap 1.05 mm at the face centre, 1.27 mm at the far magnets): gearbox and train backlash, guess
strong_enough.misalignment: 0.5 mm lateral each way and 1.5 degree twist: hinge sled and axle play, disc lock-pin play, guess
strong_enough.met: yes at a 2 degree lead-in (1.28x at Br 1.17); no at 3 degrees (0.93x)

side_faces.note: a climb with a neighbour touching each side face: no magnet size meets both bounds (the capture minimum alone gives 1.5 x (0.129 + 0.099) = 0.342 N m); needs the hinge regeared to at least 0.40 N m (more with friction, see sim) or the planner rule: no pivot while a side face touches a neighbour

chosen.part: NdFeB N35 disc 4 x 1 mm, axial

inertia_note: CAD, cad/report.txt (each part a uniform solid of its mass)
pivot_rate_note: free 14.9 rpm at the foot (derived); 60 deg/s under load is a guess (gravity 0.125 of 0.438)

disc_lock.type: 2.5 mm hardened dowel at r 15.6 mm, spring-engaged into one of 4 holes in a 0.8 mm 304 ring under the disc; SMA (0.15 mm Flexinol, 52 mm) pulls it
disc_lock.release: heat SMA, turn past 5 degrees, stop heating; the pin rides the ring and snaps into the next quarter turn

disc_bearing: 6800ZZ (10 x 19 x 5), NSK or NTN (C0 0.65-0.93 kN by maker); lip over the outer race, pressed in from below
